annotations.title: Clear a form's pinned Drive folder

description: Stop pinning a Google Drive folder for this form, so Fillo goes back to creating its own per-form folder. Files already uploaded stay where they are. Needs storage:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_reset_drive_folder
